nodes.label: Deployment Targets
nodes.rationale: Frontend on Vercel/Netlify, backend on Railway/Render, database on Supabase/Neon/Railway.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Database Setup
nodes.rationale: Supabase transaction pooler on 6543 for DATABASE_URL and direct 5432 for DIRECT_URL.

nodes.label: Supabase Storage Option
nodes.rationale: Images may live on the server disk or in Supabase Storage depending on configuration.

nodes.label: Image Upload Pipeline
nodes.rationale: multer then sharp resize/optimize with metadata stripped, stored on local disk or Supabase Storage.

nodes.label: Admin Panel
nodes.rationale: Authorized users publish news, order gallery photos and manage events; some roles edit only their own stage.

nodes.label: Batallon 11 Institutional Site
nodes.rationale: Digital replacement for the group's physical noticeboard, reachable from phone or desktop.

nodes.label: pnpm Workspace Layout
nodes.rationale: client/ holds the visible site, server/ the data engine; one pnpm install covers both.

nodes.label: Public Site Sections
nodes.rationale: Home, stages, posts, events, location and contact are readable with no registration.

nodes.label: Stage Pages
nodes.rationale: Each stage gets its own route with emblem, description, up to 4 posts and a gallery, with a 'Ver mas' overflow button.

nodes.label: Security Audit CI Job
nodes.rationale: Frozen-lockfile install plus pnpm audit at moderate level and both test suites on push and PR.

nodes.label: Organization JSON-LD Schema
nodes.rationale: schema.org Organization block naming the group and locating it in Cordoba, Argentina.

nodes.label: React Root Mount
nodes.rationale: Single #root div with /src/main.jsx as the module entry point.

nodes.label: SEO and Open Graph Metadata
nodes.rationale: Spanish-locale description, keywords, canonical URL and og/twitter cards pointing at batallon11.com.

nodes.label: Crawler Policy
nodes.rationale: Allows the whole site but disallows /admin and /p/, keeping the admin panel and gate-token URLs out of search indexes.

nodes.label: Workspace Packages
nodes.rationale: client and server are the only two workspace members.

nodes.label: Dependency Security Overrides
nodes.rationale: Pinned minimum versions for shell-quote, qs, babel, esbuild, brace-expansion, ip-address, nanoid, postcss and body-parser to force patched transitive deps.

nodes.label: EADB M.E.S. Emblem
nodes.rationale: National Exploradores Argentinos de Don Bosco emblem: white fleur-de-lis over a red cross with a handshake and an Argentine flag band, lettered '- M. E. S. -'.

nodes.label: Battalion Group Photo Hero
nodes.rationale: Outdoor group photograph of the whole battalion in dress uniform with band instruments under pines, behind a 'BATALLON 11' banner; used as the hero background of the first section.

nodes.label: Baqueanos Emblem
nodes.rationale: Blue disc with a gloved hand raising a lit torch under the Southern Cross constellation - guide and navigation symbolism.

nodes.label: Caminantes y Chispistas Emblem
nodes.rationale: Green triangle with a hand striking a spark into kindling above a woodpile - the 'chispa' (spark) that names the stage.

nodes.label: Horneros y Pichones Emblem
nodes.rationale: Green panel with an ovenbird nest on a branch and a fledgling below, matching the youngest stage's nest-and-chick symbolism.

nodes.label: Pioneros y Fuegos Emblem
nodes.rationale: Orange disc with a full campfire burning on stacked logs, the fire fully alight rather than being struck.

nodes.label: Rastreadores Emblem
nodes.rationale: Red disc with a white chapel and bell tower, a campfire in the doorway arch and a Don Bosco profile at the right.

nodes.label: Soles Emblem
nodes.rationale: Green disc with a dark red cross overlaid by a yellow radiating sun, the oldest stage's sun-and-cross device.

nodes.label: Batallon 11 Crest
nodes.rationale: Circular crest: Cordoba Cabildo towers and arch, a Don Bosco portrait and the motto 'Siempre Listo', ringed by 'Batallon 11 Gral. Jose M. Paz - Cordoba - Capital'. Used as favicon, apple-touch-icon and og:image.

nodes.label: Battalion Leaders 2026-2028
nodes.rationale: Composed card: two leaders behind large 'M.E.S.' letters, captioned 'Jefes de Batallon 2026 - 2028' with both organisation emblems along the divider.

nodes.label: Client Layout Structure
nodes.rationale: Two top-level layouts, PublicLayout and AdminLayout behind ProtectedRoute, with cookie-based axios so no manual token attachment.

nodes.label: General vs Per-Stage Content Model
nodes.rationale: Posts and galleries exist twice, general and per-stage, mirrored across controllers, routes and admin pages; a fix in one usually needs the sibling.

nodes.label: Gate Token Admin Access
nodes.rationale: No public login form: admin access starts from a one-time gate token URL that exchanges for a short-lived session.

nodes.label: Role and Stage Scoping
nodes.rationale: COORDINATOR accounts are pinned to one stage so they can never touch another stage's content.

nodes.label: Hardened Security Posture
nodes.rationale: Strict CSP, CORS allowlist, rate limiting, audit logging and encryption at rest are deliberate and must not be loosened to make something work.

nodes.label: Stages as Static Config
nodes.rationale: The six etapas are fixed in shared/stagesData.json rather than a DB table, so adding one is an edit not a migration.
